title: Prophet's Fall
description: Watch results for Prophet's Fall — a reach of pilgrim sages, the Crisp, and the tomb of the prophet.

prompts.text: A sung prayer to the prophet sounds up from below deck.
A small floating shrine of exquisite beauty drifts by.
The calming smell of incense wafts over the ship.
A fresh tear in the Crisp; the green below steams and attracts insects and birds.
A colourful swarm of birds circles the ship for a while.
The lights of a Signal Trap pulsate gently in the distance.
A group of ascetic sages on a ship offering guidance and blessings.
A trading ship on its lap around the ridge, eager to sell produce and other goods.
A farmer and his farmhands transport their produce on an improvised raft.
A gaggle of children play-acting the prophet's victory over the Leviathan Snake Naghee.
A group of young hunters carry their haul: a large beetle dripping thick indigo-coloured blood.
A prisoner is ritually tattooed with the black beetle before being chased away with stones.
A young razorteak with still-supple leaves, perfect for harvesting.
An old, ornery blackbeak parrot insults and harasses the crew.
A contraption of drones and moss has attached to the ship, slowly growing.
A crushing heatwave makes sleep impossible.
A shard gale whistles close by, tearing open the canopy of the Crisp.
A distress call from beneath the waves. The sender? A newly awakened and very confused Corron.
